gaps.explanation: Statement p5-6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP) total revenues 37,200,342 = General 16,155,680 + Streets Engineering 5,084,174 + Sales Tax 7,154,333 + 1/2 Cent Sales Tax 3,312,959 + Other Governmental Funds 5,493,196. detail = budget-basis schedules p13 General 15,673,122 + p14 Streets/Engineering 5,098,058 + p15 Sales Tax 7,081,200 + p16 1/2 Sales Tax 6,278,347 + nonmajor combining statement 5,493,196 (equals the Other column exactly) = 39,623,923. No line is missing or duplicated; the difference is budget basis vs GAAP per fund: General -482,558 (GAAP 16,155,680 vs budget 15,673,122), Streets +13,884 (budget 5,098,058 vs GAAP 5,084,174), Sales Tax -73,133 (budget 7,081,200 vs GAAP 7,154,333), 1/2 Cent +2,965,388 (budget 6,278,347 incl. Donations 3,025,000 p16 vs GAAP 3,312,959 with Grants 25,000; the 3,000,000 was GAAP revenue in FY2024). Net: -482,558 + 13,884 - 73,133 + 2,965,388 = 2,423,581 = schedule above statement.

Statement p5-6 total expenditures 41,466,741 = General 27,307,426 + Streets Engineering 6,839,459 + 1/2 Cent 1,559,970 + Other Governmental Funds 5,759,886. detail: budget schedules General 28,719,492 (p13) + Streets/Engineering 6,063,113 (p14) + 1/2 Sales Tax 1,559,970 (p16) + nonmajor combining 5,759,886 (= Other column) = 42,102,461. Budget basis vs GAAP: General budget 28,719,492 - GAAP 27,307,426 = +1,412,066; Streets budget 6,063,113 - GAAP 6,839,459 = -776,346 (Public works 2,251,168 budget vs 3,027,514 GAAP). Net +635,720 = schedule above statement. No fix.

Statement p5-6 Transfers in 16,284,701 = General 13,568,597 + Streets 1,040,524 + Other Governmental Funds 1,675,580. detail: General budget schedule 'Transfers in (out), net' 13,105,897 (p13, index 14) + Streets/Engineering 'Transfers in (out), net' 140,524 (p14, index 22) + nonmajor transfers in 1,675,580 = 14,922,001. The budget schedules print only net transfers: General 13,568,597 - 462,700 = 13,105,897; Streets 1,040,524 - 900,000 = 140,524 (both equal the p5 gross amounts netted). Fix: replace the two net lines with the gross amounts from p5 (remove indexes 14 and 22; add Transfers In 13,568,597 and 1,040,524 here, Transfers Out -462,700 and -900,000 under transfers_out). Check: 14,922,001 - 13,105,897 - 140,524 + 13,568,597 + 1,040,524 = 16,284,701 (exact).
